name: vyotiq
description: Agent V — coding workspace for real repositories
author: Vyotiq

scripts.dev: pnpm sync:harness && pnpm sync:file-icons && pnpm sync:spinner && electron-vite dev
scripts.build:vite: pnpm sync:harness && pnpm sync:docx-md && pnpm sync:app-icon && pnpm sync:spinner && pnpm sync:file-icons && electron-vite build
scripts.typecheck:tests: tsc -p tsconfig.tests-node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests-web.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests-e2e.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm sync:harness && pnpm sync:docx-md && node scripts/test-exit-wrapper.cjs
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm sync:harness && pnpm sync:docx-md && vitest run --coverage
scripts.test:reliability: vitest run tests/main/unit/runsState.test.ts tests/main/unit/agentLoopResume.test.ts tests/main/unit/followUpStore.test.ts tests/main/unit/loopCheckpoint.test.ts tests/main/unit/runRegistry.test.ts tests/main/unit/eventAppendQueue.test.ts tests/main/unit/networkMonitor.test.ts tests/main/unit/codeindex.search.test.ts tests/main/unit/globIndex.test.ts tests/main/audit/enduranceRun.audit.test.ts tests/main/audit/largeRepoScanCap.audit.test.ts tests/renderer/chat/autoResume.test.tsx tests/renderer/chat/chatStreamController
scripts.pack: pnpm pack:clean && pnpm build && electron-builder --win --mac --linux --publish never
scripts.pack:win: pnpm pack:clean && pnpm build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.pack:win:alt: pnpm pack:clean && pnpm build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never --config.directories.output=dist-package-alt
scripts.pack:mac: pnpm pack:clean && pnpm build && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.pack:linux: pnpm pack:clean && pnpm build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.pack:dir:win: pnpm pack:clean && pnpm build && electron-builder --win dir --publish never
scripts.pack:dir:win:alt: pnpm pack:clean && pnpm build && electron-builder --win dir --publish never --config.directories.output=dist-package-alt
scripts.postinstall: node node_modules/electron/install.js && (electron-builder install-app-deps || node -e "console.warn('[vyotiq] native module rebuild failed — node-pty will use pipe fallback if unavailable')") && node scripts/sync-file-icons.mjs && node scripts/sync-harness.mjs && node scripts/sync-docx-md.mjs && node scripts/generate-precision-mono-brand.mjs
